newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July lead output rises 5.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July lead output rises 5.6 percent.

text.p: Peru's lead output rose 5.6 percent to 20,911 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production rose 9.6 percent to 143,713 tonnes in the first seven months of the year compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
In 1995, lead output dipped 0.4 percent to 232,540 tonnes compared with 233,510 tonnes the previous year.
Peru is the world's number three lead producer. State-owned Centromin is the country's largest producer of the metal.
